def unique_element(lst):
    """
    Check whether a list of numbers contains only one distinct element.
    
    Args:
        lst (list): List of numbers
        
    Returns:
        bool: True if all elements are the same, False otherwise
        
    Examples:
        >>> unique_element([1, 1, 1])
        True
        >>> unique_element([])
        True   # Empty list has no distinct elements, so vacuously true
        >>> unique_element([1, 2, 3])
        False
        >>> unique_element([5])
        True
    """
    if not lst:
        return True
    
    first = lst[0]
    for num in lst:
        if num != first:
            return False
    return True


# Test cases
assert unique_element([1, 1, 1]) == True
assert unique_element([]) == True
assert unique_element([5]) == True
assert unique_element([1, 2, 3]) == False
assert unique_element([-1, -1, -1]) == True

print("All tests passed!")
